name: STensoRRF
aliases: tensorial able relighting radiance field for single-tensor scene representation
definition: A relighting solution for implicit scene reconstruction that uses a single 4D tensor to represent the scene, combining the reflectance equation and tensor decomposition to accelerate convergence and enable relighting.
summary: STensoRRF is a differentiable volume rendering method using a single decomposed 4D tensor and per-point BRDF estimation to enable high-quality novel view synthesis and relighting with faster convergence than standard NeRFs.
